# SBIR.gov solicitation fixtures

`documented_shape.json` is a synthetic, documentation-derived record containing every field
listed by the official [SBIR.gov Solicitation API](https://www.sbir.gov/api/solicitation), including
one nested subtopic. It is not represented as a live API capture and its values are not research
evidence.

The fixture was assembled on 2026-08-04 because the official page stated that the APIs were under
maintenance. Replace or supplement it with a manifested live response before the Phase 0 adapter
coverage gate can pass.
